Received used items!! I would've given this 0 Stars if I could! I bought this as a holiday gift for my nephew, I was completely horrified when he opened it and saw that everything inside was used!! There were finger smudges on the lens, dirt on the foam piece that goes against your forehead, the cords were tangled and stuffed inside the box. Needless to say I was horrified and completely embarrassed. My nephew thought I bought him the gift used. I ordered the gift again from a different carrier and I included 2 pictures of what each one looked like when the box was first opened - clearly you can see the difference between new and used!! This was not what I paid for it and not what I expected! Very disappointed...
